gotchas: Registration lives at https://www.britishairways.com/nx/b/account/en/gbr/account/registration/ (header 'Log in' (#log-button) -> /account/pre-login/ -> 'Create an account'). A OneTrust cookie wall intercepts the header click first: click #onetrust-reject-all-handler.

The registration page first asks which account to create: 'Join the Club' (The British Airways Club, the loyalty scheme formerly Executive Club) or 'British Airways account only'. Pick 'Join the Club' for the loyalty account; the wizard then runs 1 Your account -> 2 Login details -> 3 Personal details -> 4 Contact details -> 5 Marketing preferences, with Continue / Previous step buttons.

Login details step: Email address and Create password only (no confirm field). Password rule: 10 to 20 characters, upper and lower case letters, at least 1 number, no spaces. Personal and contact details steps were not observed.
Input names are not plain: target the email with input[name*="mail" i]; there are two inputs whose id contains 'assword', so use input[type="password"] (exactly one).

'British Airways account only' path: Login details (email + password) -> Personal details (Title select[id*="title" i], first/last, phone country select[id*="country" i] + required phone input[type="tel"][id*="hone" i]) -> ...
The phone is validated (aria-invalid) and required; a whole E.164 number in the national box is refused. Needs phone_national + a country-code select.
